title: Identity closure
positive: Source, decoder/runtime, projection, authority and logical-release identities are exact and mutually bound.
hostile: Alter one determinant; the selected path refuses or produces a distinct identity with explained lineage.

title: Authority without inference
positive: Every semantic/routing/design premise comes from competent exact authority.
hostile: A missing premise remains missing; label equality, numeric equality and compiler defaults cannot substitute.

title: Epistemic-class succession
positive: Mechanical succession preserves manual, derived, precedent, unresolved, review and prohibited classes.
hostile: A recovered old artifact cannot become current without its exact succession disposition.

title: Encoding boundary
positive: D01 recognizes only its exact source/encoding contract and preserves governed values.
hostile: Unknown SHA, malformed text and absent encoding declaration cannot trigger a global permissive fallback.

title: Opaque date/text
positive: D02 preserves the declared physical identity of opaque date/text carriers.
hostile: Coercion, timezone/date reinterpretation or lost typed value is detected.

title: Numeric key law
positive: G01 operates only under the accepted value-key equivalence law.
hostile: Do not collapse distinct types/values globally merely to make joins pass.

title: Bidirectional conditional arithmetic
positive: Use one common risk set, exhaustive partition and consistent measure; compute both directions from exact joint evidence.
hostile: Proposed fixture: P1 has yes=54/no=6, P2 yes=8/no=32. P(yes|P1)=54/60; P(P1|yes)=54/62. These are fixture expectations, not survey findings or a universal model law.

title: Attitude and joint conditioning
positive: Attitude-to-attitude and known-configuration-to-remaining-target queries preserve exact conditioners and support.
hostile: A condition change must change the query identity; incompatible risk/measure contexts refuse composition.

title: Higher-order signal
positive: XOR/parity and equal-marginal/different-joint fixtures survive discovery and consumer use.
hostile: No pairwise or marginal shortcut may erase an existing higher-order configuration.

title: Minority/counterpattern survival
positive: Supported minority, contradictory and counterpattern branches survive the composed path.
hostile: Ranking or majority selection cannot silently delete supported alternatives; underpowered remains distinct.

title: Recursive ancestry
positive: At least secondary/depth-two consumption retains parent predicates, exact cohort/risk identity and support.
hostile: Child predicates with lookalike text but different lineage cannot alias; unvisited branches remain explicitly unvisited.

title: S14 absence without co-travel loss
positive: Lawful empirical co-travel reaches the consumer when special semantic-relation authority is absent.
hostile: Only the specific semantic interpretation is blocked; empirical configuration evidence remains available.

title: Joint morphology and component scope
positive: Source-native ordering, ranked/multiselect or other governed non-scalar configuration survives.
hostile: A missing component vector or heterogeneous authority cannot be scalarized or silently assigned universal J2I roles.

title: Negative-state conservation
positive: Zero, valid-empty, underpowered, unknown, unresolved, unvisited, noncomparable, blocked and integrity failure remain distinguishable at the final consumer.
hostile: Positive-only recursive handoffs must be accompanied by access to the full negative/coverage record.

title: Direct-route legitimacy
positive: A competent direct producer can be consumed when its contract suffices.
hostile: A failed learned claim cannot be relabeled DIRECT_PRODUCER to bypass its required rule.

title: Final-consumer witness
positive: Actual producer output is consumed by a named current consumer using the public path.
hostile: Handmade final output or schema construction alone does not prove producer-to-consumer composition.

title: Computed possibility slices
positive: A provider computes slice evidence from exact empirical products and feeds the possibility primitive.
hostile: Handwritten 60/40 fixture slices qualify a consumer primitive, not the empirical provider.

title: Replay grade
positive: Every replay claim names its grade and demonstrates it in a fresh process where promised.
hostile: HISTORICAL_EXPLANATION_ONLY cannot be reported as fresh empirical recomputation.

title: Selective invalidation
positive: One exact determinant mutation reaches all and only registered affected products, with replacement or NO_CURRENT.
hostile: A missing cross-owner dependency is a failed closure witness; cache contents cannot restore authority.

title: Oracle and source accounting
positive: Freeze source/authority/workload before independent oracle materialization and freeze oracle identity before execution.
hostile: Candidate output cannot define expected truth; declared read/decoder counts and stop laws remain exact.

title: Historical versus current proof
positive: Retained LiTS/WVS products are reused under their exact historical identities and custody.
hostile: Logical replay cannot become a fresh current facade/source claim without competent succession or execution.

title: FF exact ingress
positive: The structural producer consumes exact support, uncertainty, component/risk/topology and replay context directly or by lawful dereference.
hostile: No universal wrapper and no obligation for FF to reconstruct missing empirical truth.

title: Structural ceiling/refusal
positive: Output is the weakest authorized actor-independent relation or precise refusal retaining original state.
hostile: Empirical success, correlation or a release manifest cannot supply structural or causal authority.

title: Demanded objective producers
positive: Only actual structural/consumer demands wake position, context, opportunity, topology or consequence functions.
hostile: Absence of one claim-specific mechanism does not block unrelated objective producers.

title: Mechanism/rule population
positive: A claimed mechanism/consequence has a competent rule and real structural inputs.
hostile: SDTF request/redrive machinery alone cannot establish a populated mechanism or world response.

title: Multi-field positive witness
positive: At least two source-indexed lawful fields contribute to a declared world consumer under exact operation authority.
hostile: No synthetic respondent table or joint distribution inferred from separate marginals.

title: Coverage conservation
positive: All 35 source identities and every demanded edge/function cell are accounted for; inherited generic proof is explicit.
hostile: Do not drop difficult sources, replace the census with an unperformed rerun or call two canaries universal proof.

title: Cross-source mismatch refusal
positive: Distinct linkage, nonduplication, pooling, measurement and estimand authorities are checked only where needed.
hostile: One relation kind cannot substitute for another; absent transport preserves local validity.

title: Comparable-wave witness
positive: Exact wave products, population/risk/design/measure mismatches and positive bridges are bound before temporal comparison.
hostile: Two waves without authority yield typed noncomparability, not inferred movement.

title: Temporal production versus admission
positive: A current producer creates the declared empirical movement or structural temporal product and a consumer uses it.
hostile: Temporal ingress/dedup or a historical code file alone cannot establish current temporal-pressure service.

title: World dependency closure
positive: Snapshot dependencies span required empirical, learned, structural, temporal and serving owners.
hostile: Local B5 traversal proves only registered closure; missing required registrations fail world acceptance.

title: Current and historical serving
positive: Exact release/current selection/as-of retrieval, permissions, negatives, provenance and rebuild grade work across required families.
hostile: An unavailable or stale family remains explicit; it cannot be masked by a serving cache.

title: Progressive possibility
positive: Known position/configuration updates plausible joint alternatives using governed slices and world context while retaining minority support.
hostile: Independent attitude draws, unauthorized smoothing and stereotype defaults cannot replace the joint service.

title: Sampling-unit firewall
positive: Individual possibility and household/coparent-dyad claims use their own sampling-unit/linkage authority.
hostile: Same-respondent survey evidence alone cannot authorize a dyad; a dyad block need not block individual possibility.

title: Actor wake threshold
positive: All mandatory F gates, declared estate, positive world content, encounterable ontology and operational integrity precede an explicit wake decision.
hostile: Correct refusals alone, test totals or historical stage parity cannot wake V3; probability remains separate from personhood.
